message: Field "Post.count": native type "@db.Long" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it: Prisma 6 stores an Int field as BSON long without it too, so removing it changes nothing in the Prisma 6 app.

Field "Post.title": native type "@db.String" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it: Prisma 6 stores a String field as BSON string without it too, so removing it changes nothing in the Prisma 6 app.

Field "Post.number": @db.ObjectId is only supported on a String field, and this field is "Int". Remove @db.ObjectId, or change the field type to String. Prisma 6 does not accept @db.ObjectId on an Int field either.

Field "Post.small": native type "@db.Int" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it; this also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client then stores new Int values as BSON long instead of int, while stored documents keep int.

Field "Post.stamp": native type "@db.Timestamp" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it; this also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client then stores new DateTime values as BSON date instead of timestamp, while stored documents keep timestamp.
Field "Post.ratio": native type "@db.Decimal" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Prisma 6 does not accept @db.Decimal on a Float field either; remove it.

Field "Post.reference": @db.ObjectId is only supported on a String field, and this field is "Bytes". Remove @db.ObjectId, or change the field type to String. Removing it makes the Prisma 6 client store new values as BSON binData instead of objectId, while stored documents keep objectId; changing the type to String makes the Prisma 6 app read and write the value as a hex string, with the stored values unchanged.
